en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hafs Bin al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If there was a slave girl for a man, so he gets her married to an owned slave of him, so he can separate between them when he so desires to, and gathers between them when he so desires to’.
